text:
Want Mount Fuji at first light from Lake Kawaguchi, with no car? Save this 5-step checklist. The sightseeing buses don't start until 9:00, so the plan has to work without them 👇

🛏️ Which side would you sleep on? Our pick is here 👉 https://japanbystation.com/lake-kawaguchi-station-or-lake-view

1️⃣ SLEEP NEAR THE STATION

Kawaguchiko Station Inn is 100 m from the platform. Our sample price was ¥13,200 for two on Wed 16 Dec, twin room with shared bathroom.

2️⃣ EAT EARLY, BRING CASH

Hoto Fudo's station branch lists 11:00 to 19:00, or until sold out. It doesn't take cards or e-money. Aim to sit down by 18:00.

3️⃣ SET THE ALARM FOR THE 05:49

On JR East's December 2026 timetable, the 05:49 local from Kawaguchiko reaches Shimoyoshida at 06:03.

4️⃣ WALK AND CLIMB

Arakurayama Sengen Park is about 10 minutes on foot from Shimoyoshida, then 398 steps up to the Chureito Pagoda view. It's free and open all day. There's also a sloping footpath.

🌙 THE NIGHT BEFORE

The last Red Line bus from the station to the north shore leaves at 17:45, which is another reason to keep this night simple and close to the platform.

5️⃣ CHECK THE SKY FIRST

Reviewers warn that clouds often hide Fuji. Look out of the window before you leave.

💡 IF YOU'D RATHER NOT MOVE AT ALL

A lakeside ryokan room sold as "Mt. Fuji view" puts the view in your room. At Lakeland Hotel Mizunosato it was ¥12,100 more than a no-view room, and a "lake view" room is a different room type.
